params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { groups: [{ heading, collapsed?, fields: [{ key, type (text, number, range, color, select, switch), label, required?, disabled?, hidden?, visibleWhen?, options?, min?, max?, step? }] }] }.

params.name: Values
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: the property values keyed by field key.

params.name: Errors
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: host-side validation messages keyed by field key.

params.name: State
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: live per-property { disabled?, hidden? } keyed by field key.

notes: New component (issue #429). OnPropertyChange carries PkPropertyChangeEventArgs (generated from the mapping's events list). Dynamic binding: change Values/State/Errors and the grid updates in place.
